profile.headline: Software Engineer · Backend Systems, APIs & Test Automation
profile.summary: Software engineer in Singapore and NUS Computer Science graduate. I build backend services and APIs in TypeScript/Node.js and Java/Spring Boot, and I care about what keeps them reliable in production: meaningful metrics and alerting, thorough automated tests, and documented root-cause analysis. This website is itself one of my projects: a TypeScript backend with Redis caching, asynchronous event ingestion and live observability.

highlights: Developed the backend and API layer (16 endpoints) for a server-driven App Store / Google Play review-invitation system in TypeScript/Node.js, replacing hard-coded app rules with admin-configured campaigns and a maker-checker approval workflow; shipped to production in Aug 2026.
Designed and built business metrics for a software-release platform in Java/Spring Boot, with root-cause miss reasons and growth-based alerting that made a silent failure class alertable.

Grew a 27K-line device platform's unit tests from 7 to 1,005 cases (79 suites) in two weeks, uncovering 9 production defects, such as a cache-key mismatch and a stalled background job, each documented with root cause and fix.

experiences.role: Software Development Engineer in Test Intern
highlights: Led testing for the Superfan/Treasure Box rollout, validating end-to-end financial logic including multi-stage revenue clearing, creator commission splitting, and settlement balance handling.

Designed comprehensive test strategies for the ToB Merchant Onboarding SDK using boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning; verified API payloads against database records to uncover critical logic flaws in contract lifecycles.
Engineered robust automation frameworks by refactoring Pytest suites to support parallel execution.
Automated validation for TTOP subscription settlements to verify third-party developer payout adjustments, ensuring accurate reconciliation of channel reports and variable FX rates.
Automated software package verification for the North-East Line (NEL) system by developing Groovy scripts within Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, improving testing efficiency.
Developed a Python comparator tool using Pandas and NumPy to automate validation of equipment aliases and classes against database records, improving data integrity.
Configured and managed virtual machines across Windows 7, Unix RHEL 5 and several Red Hat Linux versions to test SCADA software compatibility and performance.

education.qualification: Bachelor of Computing (Honours) in Computer Science

projects.title: Portfolio & Live Telemetry Platform
projects.summary: This website: a TypeScript backend with Redis caching, async event ingestion, rate limiting and live observability.
projects.description: A Fastify API in a layered MVC structure backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Content is served cache-aside with single-flight loading and TTL jitter; telemetry events are buffered in Redis and flushed in batches by a worker; the contact form is protected by an atomic Lua sliding-window rate limiter. Every retry and fallback is logged and counted in Prometheus metrics.

projects.title: Orbital Bowling Buddy App
projects.summary: A mobile app that helps bowlers of every proficiency level track their progress.
projects.description: Co-developed during NUS Orbital (May–Aug 2023). Built the key features: an authentication framework, a real-time scoreboard driven by user input, a Performance Tracker, an interactive spare guide, and a ball collection manager. Achieved Apollo level, the second-highest tier of the NUS Orbital programme.
